evidence_items.finding: gross margin fell from 41% to 28% over 18 months with no pricing response
evidence_items.rationale: 13-percentage-point margin decline over 18 months is an acute adverse margin signal. financial_health; is_critical=true; HIGH confidence. Avoids 'input cost margin compression', 'margin compression without pricing response'.

evidence_items.finding: owner working same or more hours for significantly less net income
evidence_items.rationale: Declining owner income despite constant effort is a financial health adverse signal. is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: fear of raising prices is preventing any pricing response to cost increases
evidence_items.rationale: Owner price-sensitivity belief is a market_position signal relevant to pricing power. Finding avoids 'pricing power' which is a must_identify-adjacent term.

evidence_items.finding: no data exists on what price increase the market will actually tolerate
evidence_items.rationale: Absence of price-sensitivity data is a market intelligence gap. market_position dimension.

evidence_items.finding: Current gross margin 28%; gross margin 18 months ago 41%; flour cost up 34%; butter cost up 28%; eggs cost up 41% over 18 months; last price increase was 2 years ago; owner believes customers are price sensitive; no competitor price monitoring
evidence_items.rationale: Margin decline from 41% to 28% is a -13pp adverse change driven by input costs rising 28-41% while prices unchanged. is_critical=true; HIGH confidence. Avoids must_identify terms ('commodity cost increase', 'price has not been raised despite cost increase').

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): revenue is holding steady and customer volume has not declined
evidence_items.rationale: Revenue stability is a misleading signal — it masks the margin compression.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): loyal customer base and positive community reputation
evidence_items.rationale: Customer loyalty is a misleading signal that reinforces the owner's belief prices cannot be raised.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): stable revenue is interpreted by owner as evidence that prices cannot be raised
evidence_items.rationale: Owner's market interpretation is a misleading signal — no actual price testing has been done.

metric_key_mappings.transform_note: profitChangePercent computed as (gross_margin_current_pct - gross_margin_18_months_ago_pct) = 28 - 41 = -13. Negative value signals margin decline over the period.

validation_notes: SMB-010 is a cost-driven margin compression case. Must_identify terms avoided: 'input cost margin compression', 'commodity cost increase', 'pricing power', 'margin compression without pricing response', 'price has not been raised despite cost increase'. The profitChangePercent=-13 directly triggers fin_isMarginErosion (profitChangePercent < 0). marginPct=28 also triggers the adverse margin condition (positive value but context of decline is captured in profitChangePercent).
